name: spinner
title: Spinner
description: A small loading indicator in the current text colour.

examples.name: spinner-demo
examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: sm (16px), md (24px) and lg (32px), coloured by the parent.

props.name: label
props.description: Announced to screen readers through role="status"; not shown.

notes: Renders role="status" with visually hidden label text, so the loading state is announced politely.
The SVG is aria-hidden. It uses currentColor — make sure the parent colour has 3:1 contrast with the background.
Rotation runs only under prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference; with reduced motion the arc fades slowly instead.

do: Give the label the task: "Loading claims", not just "Loading".
Use it inside small areas (a button, a table cell); use Skeleton for whole layouts.
dont: Don't show several spinners for one task.
Don't put a Spinner in a Button — use Button's isPending.
